unlisted_practices: Full-parameter domain-specific fine-tuning of an LLM within a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework using a curated geriatric medical dataset to improve answer accuracy
Checking that domain fine-tuning preserves general capability on general benchmarks (LongBench)

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a domain-specific fine-tuning approach within a RAG framework for geriatric medical QA, evaluated on a benchmark dataset and via human evaluation of outputs.
